# CNET

> CNET is a leading technology media platform providing expert product reviews, buying guides, tech news, and consumer advice across computing, mobile, home entertainment, smart home, and emerging technologies like AI.

CNET covers the full spectrum of consumer technology with in-depth reviews, comparisons, and guides written by expert journalists. The site serves as a comprehensive resource for both tech enthusiasts and everyday consumers making purchasing decisions.

## Key Topics

- Product Reviews
- Buying Guides
- Tech News
- Mobile Phones
- Laptops
- TVs
- Smart Home
- Home Security
- Streaming Services
- AI Tools
- Gaming
- VPN
- Home Internet
- Audio Equipment
- Kitchen Appliances

## Computing & Mobile

- [Phones - Expert Reviews, Best Lists, and Pro Tips - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/phones): Expert phone reviews and buying guides for iPhones and Android devices
- [Laptops - Expert Reviews, Best Lists, and Pro Tips - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/laptops): Laptop reviews and buying guides for Windows, Mac, and business models
- [Desktops - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/desktops): Desktop computer reviews and buying guides for gaming and work
- [Tech - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech): Main tech hub with product reviews and newest technology coverage

## Home Entertainment & Audio

- [TVs - Pro Reviews, Best Lists, Format Explainers - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/home-entertainment/tvs): TV reviews, buying guides, and technology comparisons for all budgets
- [Audio - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/home-entertainment/audio): Audio equipment reviews and home theater buying guides
- [Streaming Services - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/streaming-services): Streaming service guides, reviews, and entertainment recommendations
- [Gaming - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/gaming): Gaming reviews and guides for consoles, PC, VR, and handhelds

## Smart Home & Security

- [Smart Home - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/smart-home): Smart home guides, device reviews, and Alexa command tutorials
- [Home Security - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/security): Home security reviews and guides for cameras, doorbells, and systems
- [Home - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home): Home improvement, smart home, security, and outdoor product coverage

## Home & Kitchen

- [Kitchen & Household - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/kitchen-and-household): Kitchen appliance and household product reviews and buying guides
- [Yard & Outdoors - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/yard-and-outdoors): Outdoor equipment, lawn mowers, grills, and yard maintenance guides
- [Home Internet - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/internet): Internet provider reviews, broadband guides, and 5G home internet

## Software, Services & Security

- [Services & Software - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software): Reviews and guides for software, hosting, VPN, and digital services
- [VPN - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/vpn): VPN reviews, guides, and comparisons for privacy and streaming

## News & AI

- [News - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/news): Tech news and industry updates from CNET experts
- [AI Atlas - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/ai-atlas): CNET's AI exploration hub covering AI tools, chatbots, and developments

## Optional

- [CNET: Product reviews, advice, how-tos and the latest news](https://www.cnet.com): CNET homepage with product reviews, news, deals, and expert advice
- [Entertainment - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/culture/entertainment): Entertainment news, movie reviews, streaming, and collectibles
